test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which mission, launched by ISRO in January 2025, carried the NVS-02 navigation satellite?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**GSLV-F15**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GSLV-F15** is a launch vehicle developed by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• It is a part of the **Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV) series**, which is designed to launch heavier satellites into geostationary orbits.
 
• The **NVS-02 navigation satellite** was launched onboard the **GSLV-F15** in **January 2025**.
 
• NVS-02 is a satellite in the **Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC)** system, which aims to provide precise positioning services over India and its surroundings.
 
• The GSLV series employs a combination of solid, liquid, and cryogenic stages, making it capable of launching satellites weighing up to **2–2.5 tons**.
 
• It is equipped with advanced technologies to ensure successful satellite deployment in the desired orbit.
 
• The mission signifies India's growing technological capabilities in the area of **space navigation and satellite deployment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PSLV-C55**__

 __
 
• **PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle)** is primarily used for launching satellites into **polar orbits**.
 
• It is one of ISRO's most reliable launch vehicles, often used for smaller payloads and low Earth orbit missions.
 
• PSLV has successfully launched various Indian and international satellites but is not typically used for navigation satellites like NVS-02.
 
 
 
• **LVM3-M5**__
 __
 
• **LVM3 (Launch Vehicle Mark-3)**, also known as **GSLV Mk III**, is India's heavy-lift launch vehicle.
 
• It was famously used for missions like **Chandrayaan-2** and **Gaganyaan.**
 
• LVM3 is capable of carrying payloads up to **4 tons** to geostationary orbits but was not used for the NVS-02 mission.
 
 
 
• **GSLV-F16**__
 
 
• GSLV-F16 is another launch vehicle in the **GSLV series**, similar to GSLV-F15.
 
• While it belongs to the same family, this specific mission designation was not used for the **NVS-02 navigation satellite**.
